adaptation_notes: Header-only: the build fragment links nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json; include <nlohmann/json.hpp>.

The library throws on malformed input: parse at a boundary that catches nlohmann::json::exception and reports the reason, or parse with exceptions off (the parse call's allow_exceptions argument) and check is_discarded().
It parses bytes or a string, not a path: read the file through the assets interface where the composition has one.
Its containers allocate through std::allocator, which no hook redirects: a game that must account for that memory instantiates nlohmann::basic_json with its own allocator type.
